description: This file defines an internal struct 'CapacityPartition' in the Orleans.Caching.Internal namespace that implements a capacity partitioning scheme favoring frequently accessed items by allocating 80% of capacity to the warm queue. It includes constructors for initializing capacity with default or specified warm ratios, and computes the capacities for hot, warm, and cold queues ensuring minimum sizes and balanced distribution.
